The American dominated the final against Greece’s Maria Sakkari, winning 6-2, 6-3 to claim her second career singles title and her first at the WTA 1000 level.

Pegula’s performance featured an almost flawless first set, converting 10 of 11 first serves into points and facing no break opportunities. This win propels her to third in the world rankings and caps a week of straight-sets victories over top-50 opponents, securing her qualification for the upcoming WTA Finals.
